response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_scans, AVG(s.rate - o.a) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.rate > o.a

assumptions.assumption: The rate for each status is the mean of per-scan gbsize/spanmin. Scans with a missing gbsize or spanmin, or a spanmin of 0, are left out of that mean. They are still counted as scans.
The all-status average is the unweighted mean of the per-status rates. Statuses with no computable rate are left out of it. A NULL healtheval is treated as its own group.
The number of scans is the count of matched scan rows, not the sum of the scancount column.

alternatives.interpretation: The number of scans per status is the sum of scans.scancount (scans in each set) instead of the count of rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, SUM(sc.scancount) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_scans, AVG(s.rate - o.a) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.rate > o.a
